author: @httweets
title: Suvinder Vicky says people organising community screenings for Satluj in Punjab 'are treating it like seva' | Bollywood
text:
'People are treating it like seva'
Speaking to NDTV, Suvinder said, "When it disappeared from ZEE5, that was an even bigger shock. After waiting for so many years, it finally came out and then suddenly it was gone. We were all happy that people were finally watching it. I spoke to Honey Trehan, but there was nothing anyone could do. He stayed remarkably calm throughout. People are treating it like seva. Many had already downloaded it before it was taken down, and now they're sharing it with others. I have heard that people are taking projectors to villages across Punjab and organising screenings. Just as people do seva during Gurpurab by serving langar or chabeel, they are treating this film the same way. That has truly touched my heart."
